items.title: A cartesian square with an epimorphism, or a cocartesian square with a monomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a cartesian square with an epimorphism in the lower horizontal map is cocartesian with an epimorphism in the upper horizontal map, and dually that a cocartesian square with a monomorphism in the left vertical map is cartesian with a monomorphism in the right vertical map (statement lines 1103-1121). The proof is a complete argument: the two maps through the direct sum are formed and the hypothesis gives an exact four-term sequence, which yields cocartesianness and, through the kernel lemma, the remaining epimorphism statement (proof lines 1124-1131); the second assertion is dual (proof line 1132). The non-formal content is the two applications of the characterization through the direct sum. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
